rules.title: A 'Margin %' column is added right after Price (column E)
Every product's margin equals (Price - Cost) / Price
Margins update when a Price or a Cost changes
rules.detail: in a copy of the file where every Cost and Price was changed, 17 of 17 margins did not follow: P-62860 (row 2): with Cost 26.91 and Price 167.56 its margin is 0.518127, expected 0.839401 (difference -0.32), the same as before the change; P-31271 (row 3): with Cost 24.75 and Price 86.52 its margin is 0.14199, expected 0.713939 (difference -0.57), the same as before the change; P-82072 (row 4): with Cost 19.82 and Price 85.02 its margin is 0.300635, expected 0.766878 (difference -0.47), the same as before the change

rules.title: The margin cells are formatted as percentages
SKU, Product, Cost and Price are unchanged
